- User report indicates crash on notification tap

## Reproduction

Status: Not yet reproduced internally

Proposed steps:
1. Update to latest app version (released 2 days ago)
2. Receive push notification on iOS 17 device
3. Tap notification to open app
4. Observe crash

Environment: iOS 17 devices, latest app version

## Hypotheses

1. Recent app update introduced notification handling regression specific to iOS
2. iOS 17 API incompatibility in notification deep-linking or intent handling code
3. Notification payload parsing issue on iOS 17
4. Core app functionality intact; issue isolated to notification entry point
